questions.question: Explain contrasting religious views on gender equality.
questions.correctAnswer: Traditional Christians and Muslims believe men and women have equal spiritual worth but different social roles — men lead the church/family while women nurture children. The Catholic Church only ordains men, and traditional Islam assigns different family roles.
